risk_summary: The excerpt is quantitatively detailed and generally transparent, but relies substantially on management estimates for loan valuations, fair values, impairment, and acquired-loan accounting. Earnings declined year over year, with lower net interest income, lower noninterest income, higher expenses, and litigation accruals, indicating modestly adverse operating momentum. FDIC loss-sharing mitigates some credit risk, though uncovered portfolio losses and valuation sensitivity remain relevant concerns.
